title: Ep 52 — OpenAI's always-on dots, a White House accord with no teeth, and the gymnastics app that scores technique from a phone video
description: OpenAI's DevDay launches always-on dots agents and GPT-6.1 Sol at the same two-and-ten-dollar sticker as Claude Sonnet 5.5, ElevenLabs ships v4 Turbo voices, Perplexity adds trigger-based Automations, and the White House meeting ends in a voluntary 'morally binding' AI accord. Plus a deep dive on CheckForm Gymnastics, a small but RevenueCat-verified video technique-scoring app, niched as an adults-first Clip and Score feature for LeaguePages clubs, and goDonate's Christmas giving data for PlayFundWin's festive draws.
